mapper.select: WITH matched AS (SELECT FROM export_tasks status=#{status} AND (task_no COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_ci LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')), metadata AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS total,a.version AS activity_version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM export_tasks WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','PAUSING')) AS has_active_tasks FROM task_activity a WHERE id=1), paged AS (SELECT * FROM matched ORDER BY created_at DESC,task_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}) SELECT p.task_id,p.task_no,p.scope_type,COALESCE(p.total_count,0) AS total_count,COALESCE(p.trusted_processed_count,0) AS trusted_processed_count, p.status,p.fields_json,p.file_name,p.file_size,p.created_at,p.finished_at,p.error_code,p.error_summary, COALESCE(p.version,0) AS version,COALESCE(p.control_version,0) AS control_version,p.execution_phase,p.repair_state, COALESCE(p.repair_epoch,0) AS repair_epoch,COALESCE(p.repair_attempt,0) AS repair_attempt,p.repair_reason_code, m.total,m.activity_version,m.has_active_tasks FROM metadata m LEFT JOIN paged p ON TRUE ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.task_id DESC
SELECT ,0 AS total,0 AS activity_version,FALSE AS has_active_tasks FROM export_tasks WHERE task_id=#{value}
